name: Edwin
about_text:
I’m a Colombian Systems Engineer with a strong background across data analytics, software development, and workflow automation. I design dashboards and data models that make information easy to use and automate repetitive steps to improve accuracy and speed. My toolkit includes Power BI/DAX, Excel Power Query, Python, SQL, VBA, Power Automate, I use the right tool for the job to deliver practical, scalable results.

I enjoy turning messy data into clear decisions, documenting solutions so they’re easy to maintain, and measuring impact (less manual work, faster refresh, fewer errors). I work well with stakeholders, ask the right questions, and iterate quickly—sharing code, templates, and simple guides so teams can reuse the solution.
